headline: Lees-McRae still unbeaten with Young Harris to come
dek: Lees-McRae have won thirteen and drawn three without a defeat, conceding seven goals in all. They are the only side yet to lose a conference match, and their last one is at home to Young Harris, who lead the conference table.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Chowan's 47 goals have come from at least fifteen different scorers and have still brought four defeats; spreading the scoring has not bought a clean record.

wire.line: Erskine are now the only side in the conference without a win.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Thirteen matches dated before today carry no result at all, the earliest Converse's home match against Spartanburg Methodist and the latest Berry's home match against Shorter.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Francis Marion have won eleven matches, drawn two and lost four, and have conceded twelve goals in all.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Young Harris have won eleven matches, drawn three and lost three, scoring 43 goals and conceding twenty.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Andre Camargo, a freshman, has scored ten goals and set up five for Chowan, from 32 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Edouard Laberge has made 81 saves for Emmanuel and conceded 22 goals, a save percentage of .786.

last_match.line: Barton have not lost since Francis Marion beat them in September, and have now returned the result.

next_match.line: Lees-McRae have yet to lose; both of Young Harris's conference defeats came at Converse.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
